payload.description:
**Blocked by:** nothing. Deliberately tiny, because three tasks fork from it and they must agree on the shape before they start.

Principal is a frozen dataclass with a kind (user or worker), tenant_id, and either user_id with membership status and role, or worker_id. Add the FastAPI dependency that will resolve it and the explicit marker that declares a route reachable by a waitlisted member. No resolver implementations and no enforcement in this task.

Routing is default deny by construction: a route serves an enabled member unless it is explicitly marked otherwise. Do not build a denylist of expensive routes. The next route someone adds would be open by default, and one day that route is the one that calls the model.

**Done when:** the type and the marker are merged so the JWT, worker credential, and route-reshaping tasks can proceed against them in parallel.
payload.title: Define the Principal seam and the waitlist-safe route marker
